```{r verify-inputs, echo=FALSE}
raw <- read.delim(params$raw, check.names = FALSE)
tin <- read.delim(params$tin, check.names = FALSE)
qc <- read.delim(params$qc, check.names = FALSE)

stopifnot(nrow(raw) == 4)
stopifnot(nrow(tin) == 4)
stopifnot(nrow(qc) == 4)
```

Raw rows: `r nrow(raw)`

TIN rows: `r nrow(tin)`

QC rows: `r nrow(qc)`

Annotation enabled: `r toupper(as.character(params$annot))`
